definition.title: Bit-free trace of the original G04 optical guards
definition.measurement: Exact original ink_word_regions geometry, resampler, foreground and guard order; no repair. Original edge-background medians are retained for polarity; gap-row medians are not computed.
definition.polarity: selectedByOriginalRule only: scanline edge median maxRGB>170 selects black(maxRGB<130), otherwise white(minRGB>170 and spread<70). Not source ground truth.
definition.continuation: After first word failure, continue every remaining lexical word only as counterfactual-after-first-word-failure. Earlier guard failures retain their baseline priority; later-stage column flags are diagnostic only.
definition.rowGuardPolicy: A pre-word-loop row guard has NULL failedWordID/index. Do not invent per-word pixel diagnostics after an invalid row envelope.
definition.comparison: Compare first optical failure or optical pass for all142 rows to the pinned original G04 RESULT. No post-span nonpositive-gap check is performed.
definition.punctuation: Report the15 pinned punctuation records and NULL boxes; do not locate, repair or assign glyphs.
definition.safeResult: Aggregate source/guard/continuation counts and integrity pins only; no row IDs, word IDs, coordinates, polarity runs or source text.
limitations: This is a diagnostic, not a puzzle/key result or repaired measurement.
Only first optical guards are comparable to the original short-circuit row receipt.
Continuation after failure and column flags after an earlier guard are counterfactual diagnostics.
No source support/polarity correction or downstream gap guard is tested.

registrationPolicy: The actual public Git commit containing this protocol and exact code/input blobs must be verified before target execution. This timestamp records protocol finalization, not proof of public registration.
